description_en: Enables or initiates a shutdown of password-free access over a VPC. After this feature is enabled, cloud servers in the same VPC can connect to the ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance without a password. Connections using a username and password are still supported
description_zh: 开启或关闭专有网络免密访问。开启后，同一专有网络内的云服务器无需使用密码即可连接云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例，同时也继续兼容通过用户名和密码的方式连接实例
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore modify-instance-vpc-auth-mode --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --vpc-auth-mode Close --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceVpcAuthMode

parameters.help_en:
The authentication mode in a VPC. Valid values:
Open: Uses password authentication.
Close: Disables password authentication and enables password-free access.

Default value: Open
parameters.help_zh:
专有网络下的认证模式，取值：
Open：通过密码认证。
Close：关闭密码认证，即开启免密访问。

默认值为Open
parameters.name: vpc_auth_mode
